tex_content.html:
Lemma
[Smooth rescalings of smooth sections]

Let $V$ be a smooth vector bundle over a smooth manifold $B$, let $s$ be a smooth section, and let $c:B\to \mathbb R$ be smooth. Then $b\mapsto c(b)s_b$ is smooth.
